source.check: names read from the page images; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1905: polled 25 May 1905 in five divisions (counted 26 May by T. W. Kilpatrick, returning officer). Markethill is not filed: both Armagh Guardian nomination lists print "Markethill—Wm. Simpson, J.P.", the Hamiltonsbawn member, apparently in error. Returned unopposed. James Maxwell (U.) and John M'Clelland ("self styled Unionist") withdrew, leaving Donnelly to be returned unopposed.
